source: User reply to the pending in-chat source question
user_argument: Local alliances are temporary Army pieces; therefore exhausting the strength-2 alliance piece can successfully defend a strength-1 Crisis.
classification: User-supplied interpretation, expressly not an official ruling.
primary_passages_rechecked: Rules p22: alliances are temporary Army pieces; their strength can be used for Deploy and defense, once per purchase turn, without splitting among purposes.
Rules p33: exhaust Army pieces equal to Crisis strength or as many as possible; non-equality makes Crisis succeed.
Official Player Aid p2: Company defender strength includes exhausted regiments, officers and alliances; defender wins ties.
assessment: The Army-piece definition establishes eligibility to be exhausted. The yes interpretation is plausible, and the aid supports a comparative defense reading. The definition alone does not specify how printed strength is counted in the p33 equality test or whether excess is unused; it therefore does not independently establish the required source-verified counting rule.
scope: Record the argument accurately without presenting it as a publisher/designer statement or inventing an automatic excess-loss rule.
